changelog_text:
**KSP's idle and ladder animations.**

- **Idle variety:** Kerbals standing around now look around, stretch and fidget now and then, with KSP's own idle variants: seven for the male Kerbals and seven for the female ones.
- **Ladders:** Kerbals hold KSP's ladder pose when they stop, climb down with KSP's climb-down animation instead of climbing up in reverse, and climb smoothly instead of freezing.
- This needs the optional [Character Manager](https://github.com/paulo-santana/KSA-Character-Manager) 0.3.0 or later, which plays them: KSA itself has no idle variants on the ground and only one ladder clip. Without it, nothing changes.
- The download grows by about 2 MB.

listing.name: KSP Characters
listing.abstract: Adds the Kerbals from Kerbal Space Program as crew characters, with KSP's own models, textures and animations.
listing.description:
Adds the Kerbals from Kerbal Space Program as crew characters in KSA, with KSP's own models, textures and animations: male and female, in KSP's white and orange suits. New crew are a random mix of kittens and Kerbals.

It is a data mod: no code and no mod loader. With the optional Character Manager, Kerbals get Kerbal names, and Jeb, Bill, Bob and Val join every new game.

What it includes and its known limitations are in the [README](https://github.com/paulo-santana/KSA-KSP-Characters#readme).

## Credits and legal

The Kerbals' models, textures, animations and name lists come from Kerbal Space Program and belong to its rights holders. The jetpack and its textures are Kitten Space Agency's. This is a fan port, not affiliated with or endorsed by either. Only the XML definitions and the documentation are MIT licensed; see LICENSE.
